description: This bar chart illustrates the Perplexity values for two different metrics, labeled "Per-Output" (blue bars) and "Per-Token" (orange bars), across varying Sparsity Rates ranging from 10% to 80% on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. Each bar pair corresponds to a specific Sparsity Rate, with the blue bar representing Per-Output perplexity and the orange bar representing Per-Token perplexity. At 10%, both perplexity values are approximately 1.0 (10^1). As the sparsity rate increases, both metrics show a general upward trend in perplexity; for instance, at 80%, the Per-Output perplexity reaches approximately 100 (10^2) and the Per-Token perplexity reaches approximately 1000 (10^3). The bars are sorted in ascending order by Sparsity Rate along the x-axis, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color-coded distinction in the legend.
